semantic_fragments.content: An identification of known or foreseeable HAZARDS and HAZARDOUS SITUATIONS which could affect PATIENTS, USERS or others, related to the use of the MEDICAL DEVICE was performed according to ISO 14971:2019. During the identification of HAZARDS and HAZARDOUS SITUATIONS, the following was considered: USE SPECIFICATION including USER PROFILE(S); information on HAZARDS and HAZARDOUS SITUATIONS known for existing USER INTERFACES of MEDICAL DEVICES of a similar type, if available; and identified USE ERRORS.

USER INTERFACE SPECIFICATION shall consider: the USE SPECIFICATION; the known or foreseeable USE ERRORS associated with the medical device; and the HAZARD-RELATED USE SCENARIOS. Inputs to the USER INTERFACE SPECIFICATION shall include: testable technical requirements relevant to the USER INTERFACE including requirements for parts associated with selected RISK CONTROL measures; an indication as to whether ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENTATION is required; and an indication as to whether MEDICAL DEVICE specific training is required.

The USER INTERFACE EVALUATION plan for SUMMATIVE EVALUATION shall specify for each selected HAZARD-RELATED USE SCENARIO: (a) evaluation method and rationale for OBJECTIVE EVIDENCE; (b) which part of the USER INTERFACE is being evaluated; (c) where applicable, criteria for determining whether information for SAFETY is perceivable, understandable and supports CORRECT USE of the MEDICAL DEVICE (4.1.3); (d) availability of ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENTATION and provision of training during SUMMATIVE EVALUATION; and (e) for a USABILITY TEST, how the characteristics of the test participants are representative of the intended USER PROFILES.
